import math
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def wilson_ci(k, n, z=1.96):
    p = k / n
    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
    center = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / denom
    margin = z / denom * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2))
    return round((center - margin) * 100, 2), round((center + margin) * 100, 2)
